name: Volcanic Vent
primary:
The ground splits open at the aim point, any distance away: a fissure 1 block wide and 7 long cracks along your gaze, its bottom glowing with magma, and fire bursts from it.
A fiery zone with a 3-block radius for 6 s. Every second, on everyone inside except you:
• Damage 2.5 ❤ fire + 1.25 ❤ earth + 1.25 ❤ arcane (fire ×0.5 on wet, earth ×2 on frozen)
• Heat: sets on fire for 12 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Light push
• Arcane instability: −0.25 ❤ every 2 s for 4.5 s
• Launches upward
